force_refresh.description: Bypass the 1 hour member cache. Honored only for browser session callers; API key, OAuth, and MCP callers always read through the cache.

id.description: A unique integer value identifying this integration.

limit.description: Maximum number of members to return per request (max 200).

offset.description: Number of members to skip before returning results.

search.description: Optional case-insensitive member name or ID search query.

user_id.description: Look up one member directly by Slack member ID (e.g. U0123ABC). When set, `search`, `limit`, and `offset` are ignored and the response holds at most that member.
